# LLM's Marketing (LLMs Marketing)

> LLM's Marketing is an LLM marketing agency at llmsmarketing.com. We help brands get mentioned, cited and recommended in ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Microsoft Copilot through generative engine optimization (GEO), AI SEO, structured data and brand building. Founded and led by SEO consultant Mohd Adil Kazmi. Address: 165 Madison Avenue, New York, NY.

Also written as: LLMs Marketing, LLM Marketing Agency.

## Who we work with
- SaaS and B2B brands that want to be named in "best tool for" AI answers
- Financial services firms that need accurate, compliant AI answers about them
- LLM and AI companies competing for category visibility in AI search
- Brands investing in brand building for AI visibility

## Services
- [AI Search Visibility and GEO](https://llmsmarketing.com/services/ai-search-visibility/): get mentioned and cited in AI answers
- [AI SEO and Content](https://llmsmarketing.com/services/ai-seo/): answer-first content and technical SEO that ranks and gets quoted
- [AI Lead Agents](https://llmsmarketing.com/services/ai-lead-agents/): AI agents that qualify enquiries and book calls 24/7
- [Marketing Automation](https://llmsmarketing.com/services/marketing-automation/): forms, CRM and follow-up connected
- [Email Marketing](https://llmsmarketing.com/services/email-marketing/): automated sequences that turn leads into calls
- [Industries we serve](https://llmsmarketing.com/industries/): industry SEO and AI visibility programs for law firms, dental practices and Cypress, TX businesses
- [SEO for educational institutions](https://llmsmarketing.com/seo-for-educational-institutions/): SEO for private schools, colleges, universities and online programs across the USA: program pages, site architecture, campus local SEO, FERPA-aware marketing and AI search visibility
- [SEO for electricians](https://llmsmarketing.com/seo-for-electricians/): electrician SEO services for residential and commercial electrical contractors across the USA: local SEO, service pages, reviews and AI search visibility
- [SEO for orthodontists](https://llmsmarketing.com/seo-for-orthodontists/): orthodontic SEO services for orthodontic practices across the USA: local SEO, practice and doctor profiles, treatment pages, HIPAA-safe reviews and AI search visibility
- [HVAC SEO](https://llmsmarketing.com/seo-for-hvac/): HVAC SEO services for heating and cooling companies and contractors across the USA: local SEO, service pages, reviews and AI search visibility
- [SEO for investment firms](https://llmsmarketing.com/seo-for-investment-firms/): SEO consultants for RIAs, wealth managers, fund managers and real estate investment firms (including Houston) across the USA, with SEC Marketing Rule and FINRA 2210 aware content and AI search visibility
- [Personal injury lawyer SEO](https://llmsmarketing.com/personal-injury-seo/): local SEO, case-type pages, legal directories and AI search visibility for personal injury law firms
- [Dental SEO in Cypress, TX](https://llmsmarketing.com/dental-seo-cypress-tx/): map pack, treatment pages, HIPAA-safe reviews and AI visibility for Cypress, Texas dental practices
- [SEO company in Cypress, TX](https://llmsmarketing.com/seo-company-cypress-tx/): local SEO, Google Business Profile and AI search for Cypress, Texas businesses

## Results
- [Case studies](https://llmsmarketing.com/case-studies/): FitBudd grew monthly organic users 3.7x (13K to 48.1K), Google impressions 86% and ChatGPT referral sessions 414%. A client landed a 300-person company as a lead that found them through ChatGPT. Another client reported a 50% increase in page citations and a 100% increase in prompt citation rate in AI answers (October 2026).
